grammar.summary: 本课以人与昆虫的关系为线索，集中运用了动名词作宾语、分词结构作状语以及 not only...but also 并列结构。课文用动名词作介词宾语表达「恐惧」「厌恶」的对象，用分词短语描写观察蚂蚁时的状态与动作，用 not only...but...强调恐惧的范围。

points.title: 动名词作宾语 (Gerund as Object)
points.explanation: 介词后用动名词（-ing 形式）作宾语，表示动作或状态。本课用 of being stung、of being filled with revulsion 等动名词短语作介词宾语，表达「被蜇」「被厌恶感充斥」等状态。

examples.en: we have a horror of being stung.
examples.cn: 我们仍然十分害怕被蜂蜇。

examples.en: Knowing that the industrious ant lives in a highly organized society does nothing to prevent us from being filled with revulsion when we find hordes of them crawling over a carefully prepared picnic lunch.
examples.cn: 即使知道勤奋的蚂蚁生活具有高度组织性的社会里，当看到大群蚂蚁在我们精心准备的午间野餐上爬行时，我们也无法抑制对它们的反感。

points.title: 分词结构作状语 (Participle Clauses)
points.explanation: 现在分词或过去分词短语可作状语，表示伴随状态、原因或方式。本课用 entranced、unaware 描述观察昆虫时的入迷状态，用 looking 修饰筏子出现时的样子，使描写生动。

examples.en: We enjoy staring at them, entranced as they go about their business, unaware (we hope) of our presence.
examples.cn: 我们喜欢入迷地看它们做事，它们不知道（但愿如此）我们就在它们身边。

examples.en: Suddenly a raft appeared, looking rather like Noah's ark, carrying the whole family, a few hens, the dogs, cat, and bird in a cage.
examples.cn: 突然，出现了一只筏子，看起来很像诺亚方舟，上面载着他们全家老小，还有几只母鸡、几只狗，一只猫与一只鸟笼，那里头有一只小鸟。

points.title: not only...but also 并列结构 (not only...but also)
points.explanation: not only...but also... 连接两个并列成分，表示「不仅……而且……」，强调递进关系。本课用此结构连接两个恐惧对象，强调人们对昆虫的恐惧范围之广。

examples.en: We live in dread not only of unpleasant insects like spiders or wasps, but of quite harmless one like moths.
examples.cn: 我们在日常生活中，不但憎恶如蜘蛛、黄蜂之类令人讨厌的昆虫，而且憎恶并无大害的飞蛾等。

exercises.q: we have a horror of ______ (be) stung.
We live in dread not only of unpleasant insects like spiders or wasps, ______ of quite harmless one like moths.
We enjoy staring at them, ______ as they go about their business, unaware (we hope) of our presence.
用现在分词填空：Suddenly a raft appeared, ______ (look) rather like Noah's ark, carrying the whole family.
课文中 the industrious ant 中 industrious 的含义最接近？
